verdict.rationale: Keycloak supports bulk changes indirectly. Realms can be imported and exported as JSON files [keycloak-docs-10], the operator can automate realm imports [keycloak-docs-76] and manage clients declaratively [keycloak-docs-43], authorization configuration can be exported and imported [keycloak-docs-71], and kcadm.sh or the Admin REST API allow scripted administration of many users, roles and clients [kc-supp-kcadm]. Operating on many items, however, means whole-realm import/export or custom scripting rather than a native bulk-operation feature. missing for 10: a documented native bulk API or admin-console multi-select actions (e.g., bulk user update or delete), SCIM bulk-operation support evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
